title: dissectors: fix a few more warnings

notes.body: This can roll over into endless loop if both `i` and `nb_of_notes` are of same sized type.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/26203/diffs?diff_id=1966181136&start_sha=76fa92d15c44d9d3aa56e20b878f718e72734414#9e899322c042e332907d6283e3fa6baa147bfecc_2485_2485)

The mask for hf_ua3g_beep_number_of_notes is 0, so the field/nb_of_notes can have the value 255.

I hadn't noticed that the test is "i \<= nb_of_notes", so I guess that a value of 0 means there should be 1 note...  Have widened "i" now.
